'''Arbian J. Lemmeloth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] who was tasked with [[Spy/Legends|spying]] on [[Republic Treasury Audit Division]] agent [[Besany Wennen]]. While tailing her through the streets of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], he was surprised from behind by [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null Arc]] [[Ordo Skirata]] and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Enacca]]. Abducted into a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]], he was scanned, and Ordo learned that Lemmeloth had a high security clearance and was a mere two promotions shy of reporting directly to the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]].

After slicing into the secure [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]] system of Republic Intelligence, Ordo sent a message clearing Wennen of any wrongdoing before [[Death/Legends|killing]] Lemmeloth with a direct shot to the head. His body was left on the lower levels for the [[borrat]]s to consume.

==Personality and traits==
Lemmeloth was middle-aged with gray [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. He had nondescript features, which were useful for a spy, and a portly build.<ref name="Order66" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Let's just check what you're carrying...oh, a nice DH-seventeen. That's not quite your style, is it?|Ordo Skirata to Arbian J. Lemmeloth|<ref name="Order66" />}}
Lemmeloth owned a [[DH-17 blaster pistol]]
<ref name="Order66" />
